description: Remember meta rewards signal density. The more signal you can give your campaign the better it can perform.  #metaadstips #facebookadvertisingtips #metaadsspecialist #facebookadstips #metaads
transcript: Is fragmentation killing your ad account? We just took over an ad account spending $200,000 per month on meta ads. And the one thing that we noticed was this brand and their past agency was just creating campaigns for literal the sake of it. There was no real identifying factor of to why this campaign was set up, what differentiation was this one versus this one. And mostly the campaigns overlapped with creative similarities, same persona types, really the same targeting, which in my opinion cause their frequency to go up and also cause their C P a to be quite high. We know meta rewards signal density, meaning it wants to have all the signal it can within that one campaign to shine that is post Andromeda. So when we took over this account, we didn't just cut everything, cause that can also be dangerous. But we looked at how we can consolidate what was winning in certain assets into other assets and looked at reducing the campaigns and assets within the account. Now of course, their Mir has decreased because they're not competing against themselves in these campaigns. Meta knows who to go after and they have consolidated and created great signal for meta to then use.
